title: SQL injection in parcel search
description: The q parameter reaches the search query unquoted; a true condition returns every customer's parcels.

proof.poc: GET /api/parcels/search?q=x%27%20OR%20%271%27%3D%271 with a customer session; proof/cand-001-response.txt is the captured response.

title: Path traversal in label download
description: The file parameter is joined to the label directory without normalisation.

proof.poc: GET /labels/download?file=..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd; proof/cand-002-response.txt is the captured response.

title: Parcel details readable by any customer
description: The parcel id is not checked against the session's account.

proof.poc: Log in as customer 2041, request parcel 7731 owned by customer 3388; proof/cand-003-transcript.txt holds both requests.

title: Server-side request forgery via webhook URL
description: The webhook URL is fetched by the server; the scanner suspects internal hosts are reachable.

proof.poc: Not captured: the scanner flagged the parameter name and saved no request or response.

title: Reflected cross-site scripting on tracking page
description: The code parameter is reflected in the tracking page.

proof.poc: GET /track?code=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C%2Fscript%3E; proof/cand-005-response.html is the captured response.
